[[Image:Anita.png|thumb|250px|Anita with Pidgey]] '''Anita''' (Japanese: '''アザミ''' ''Azami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG015|Gonna Rule the School!]]''. She initially found her time at the [[Pokémon Trainers' School]] boring, namely because she was forced to attend because of her parents. However, after seeing [[Max]] and {{OBP|Tommy|AG015}} help save some stolen {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} from {{TRT}}, her views about Pokémon changed. Anita disliked Tommy because he prided himself on being the star student and often bullied the other children. Anita would often leap to her fellow students defense, as she did for {{OBP|Kenny|AG015}} during the school trip. Her opinions of Tommy quickly changed after she joned forces with him to take down Team Rocket. {{-}} ==Pokémon== ===Borrowed=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pokémon Trainer's School |pkmn=Pidgey |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Anita Pidgey.png |epnum=AG015 |epname=Gonna Rule The School! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Megumi Hayashibara |desc={{p|Pidgey}} was first seen on a field trip with [[Roxanne]]'s Beginner Class, and again when the class was trying to get used to Pokémon. During {{TRT}}'s attempt to capture the Pokémon from the school, Kenny told Anita to have Pidgey use a Wing Attack on the {{p|Wurmple}}-shaped [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]], releasing the stolen [[Poké Ball]]s in the process.
